decode_layout: input is 64 bytes little-endian: bytes 0..32 = a (U256, LE), bytes 32..64 = b (U256, LE). If input.len() < 64 the harness returns an empty Vec without touching the crate. Output is 33 bytes: bytes 0..32 = a.wrapping_mul(&b) as 4 u64 words each little-endian, byte 32 = (a > b) constant-time comparison result (1 or 0).
